partnershipPlan: The joint steering group meets before fielding and after analysis; two patient partners review the plain-language summary.
socialListening: No social media listening; the union's anonymised member comments from last winter are read for themes.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: On a short night I decide who gets turned and who waits, and it is always the quiet ones who wait.
items.implication: Keep turning and mobilisation as separate items and report them by shift type.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: If managers can see which nurse said what, nobody will answer honestly.
items.implication: Agree the five-response reporting rule in writing before the survey opens.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I went home with three new tablets and nobody had time to explain them.
items.implication: Keep discharge teaching as an item and link the findings to the discharge process.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Half those questions are about things my scope does not cover, so I would tick not missed.
items.implication: Pretest the checklist with licensed practical nurses and add a not-applicable option.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: My father had not been out of bed for two days; the nurses were kind but there were so few of them.
items.implication: Report missed mobilisation alongside staffing, without blaming individual nurses.

summary: Five composite voices on triage of care, trust, discharge teaching, role scope and family observation.
